snapshotAssessment.finding: Stripe publishes third-party Sub-processors, service providers and Affiliates with data categories, processing purpose and entity country. The list includes processing locations both within and outside the EEA.

representativeFindings.name: Amazon Web Services, Inc.
representativeFindings.data: Business User and Representative data and End Customer data

representativeFindings.name: Salesforce, Inc.
representativeFindings.data: Information provided in communications with Stripe

representativeFindings.name: Twilio, Inc.
representativeFindings.data: Business User data and End Customer data
representativeFindings.purpose: Cloud communications, two-factor authentication and user support

representativeFindings.name: TELUS International (Cda)
representativeFindings.data: Information included in Stripe support queries

representativeFindings.name: PPRO Payment Services S.A.
representativeFindings.data: End Customer and Business User data

affiliateFindings.emeaControllerEntity: Stripe Technology Company Limited — Ireland, described as a data controller with primary responsibility for processing Personal Data outside the Americas together with relevant local regulated entities and SPEL
affiliateFindings.note: Affiliate involvement depends on Business User location, End Customer location and Stripe services used.

changeNotification.mechanism: Stripe provides a subscription mechanism for email notifications of Sub-processor-list updates.
changeNotification.noticePeriod: at least 30 days before addition of one or more Sub-processors if the Business User subscribes
changeNotification.objectionPeriod: 30 days after notice/update on legitimate grounds

limitations: Presence on Stripe's global list does not prove that every listed Sub-processor or Affiliate receives CAPITAL-AI Personal Data.
A CAPITAL-AI-specific mapping of enabled Stripe products to actual Sub-processors and processing locations remains pending.
This snapshot does not constitute a completed transfer impact assessment.
The source PDF itself is not committed to the repository.
